translator_notes: 'Усојница' is a guess ('poisonous' / 'sun-lover'). In the fourth stanza the text addresses the love but still says 'мале' (mother), kept literally. 'Поголема' rendered 'elder', my reading. Traditional.

lines.en: A girl planted flax, a girl dug flax,
the girl dug up a fierce snake,
a fierce snake, girl, a poisonous one.
The girl cried out, hey, and wept:

lines.cyr: - Ој ле, мале мори, старо мале,
lines.lat: - Oj le, male mori, staro male,

lines.en: to pull out the fierce snake!
- Oh, daughter, hey, my elder one,

lines.cyr: јас без тебе, ќерко, ќе си можам,
lines.lat: jas bez tebe, ḱerko, ḱe si možam,
lines.en: I can manage without you, daughter,

lines.cyr: но без рака, мори, јас не можам.
lines.lat: no bez raka, mori, jas ne možam.
lines.en: but without my hands, hey, I cannot.
The girl cried out, hey, and wept,

lines.cyr: - Ој ле, либе море, прво либе,
lines.lat: - Oj le, libe more, prvo libe,

lines.en: to pull out the fierce snake!

lines.cyr: - Ој ле, либе мори, прво либе,
lines.lat: - Oj le, libe mori, prvo libe,

lines.cyr: јас без рака, либе, ќе си можам,
lines.lat: jas bez raka, libe, ḱe si možam,
lines.en: I can manage without hands, love,

lines.cyr: но без тебе, либе, јас не можам.
lines.lat: no bez tebe, libe, jas ne možam.
lines.en: but without you, love, I cannot.
